transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I, um... I hope I'm explaining this the right way. I don't want to sound like a difficult person, I really don't, but... it's a family situation. 

My husband's sister, well, she's been working this family business, and... she's doing it so she can get control of the money and push me out of all the decisions. I know folks try to just smooth it over and make it seem like it's nothing, but... I know what I've been seeing for more than a year now. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one else was around?

Oh, no. No, Doctor, I haven't. I mean, sometimes I hear the house settling or the wind, just normal things, you know? But never any voices or anything like that. 

I wouldn't hide it from you if I did, I promise. I want to be completely honest so you have all the facts to work with. I just don't have anything like that going on, it's really just the stress with my sister-in-law. I hope I'm answering your questions okay? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Do you often feel that other people in your life, like friends, coworkers, or neighbors, might also be trying to deceive or take advantage of you?

Oh, no, Doctor. No, not at all. I mean, I don't work right now, so I don't have any coworkers, but my friends and my neighbors are just wonderful. We all get along real well. 

I really don't want you to think I'm the sort of person who... well, who goes around suspecting everybody of things, because I'm really not. I try to be a good neighbor and a good friend myself, and I try to see the best in folks. It's truly just this one specific situation with my sister-in-law that's been so hard. 

I hope it's okay that I'm just having trouble with her? I just don't want to come across like I'm complaining about everyone, because I promise I'm not. Did I answer that the way you needed me to?
Do you find it difficult to make everyday decisions without getting advice and reassurance from others?

Oh, no, Doctor, I don't think so. I can handle my day-to-day things just fine on my own. I mean, I figure out the grocery shopping and the household chores and all that without needing to bother anybody. 

I try real hard not to be a burden, you know? I hope that doesn't make me sound stubborn or anything... I just like to take care of my own responsibilities so folks don't have to worry about me. Well, except for the stress with my sister-in-law, of course. But for normal everyday things, I do just fine by myself. 

Is that what you were asking about? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
